# noAPI

The goal of noAPI is to make it easier for users to retrieve data from
public Norwegian APIs.

## Installation

You can install the development version of noAPI from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("Riksrevisjonen/noAPI")
```

## Examples

``` r
library(noAPI)

# Get latest exchange rate from 'Norges Bank'
get_exchange_rate('USD') 

# Get entity information from 'Enhetsregisteret'
get_entity(974760843)

# Get address information from 'Kartverket'
get_address_info('munkegata 1 trondheim')
```

For a full list of available functions please refer to the [package
documentation](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/index.html).

## Getting help

If you encounter a bug or want to submit a feature request please file
an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/Riksrevisjonen/noAPI/issues). We
kindly ask you to include a minimal reproducible example when possible.
For other questions please reach out to the package authors.

## Acknowledgements

The ship used in noAPIs logo is based on a 3D model of the Norwegian
Oseberg Viking Ship originally created by Dane Ericksen. The conversion
to a 2D black-and-white model was done by the package authors.
Ericksen’s work is licensed under [CC BY
4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`count_ssb_tags()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/count_ssb_tags.md)
  : Count SSB metadata tags
- [`find_address_from_point()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/find_address_from_point.md)
  : Find addresses within a geographical area
- [`get_address_info()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_address_info.md)
  : Get address info
- [`get_countries()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_countries.md)
  : Get countries
- [`get_entity()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_entity.md)
  : Get entity
- [`get_exchange_rate()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_exchange_rate.md)
  : Get exchange rate
- [`get_industrial_codes()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_industrial_codes.md)
  : Get Standard Industrial Classification (SIC)
- [`get_kindergartens()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_kindergartens.md)
  : Get kindergartens
- [`get_municipalities()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_municipalities.md)
  [`get_counties()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_municipalities.md)
  [`get_adm_units()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_municipalities.md)
  : Get municipalities and counties
- [`get_roles()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_roles.md)
  : Get roles
- [`get_schools()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_schools.md)
  : Get schools
- [`get_ssb_metadata()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_ssb_metadata.md)
  : Get SSB table metadata
- [`get_ssb_table()`](https://riksrevisjonen.github.io/noAPI/reference/get_ssb_table.md)
  : Get SSB table
